title: Platform Validation Matrix
objective: Menjalankan workflow inti pada seluruh platform dan konfigurasi yang didukung.

platforms.description: Daftar platform yang didukung (Windows, Linux, macOS, Web) dan status kesiapan.

os_versions.description: Versi OS yang diuji dan hasil deteksi environment.

hardware_profiles.description: Konfigurasi hardware (CPU arch, RAM tier, GPU availability) dan dampak workflow.

input_modes.description: Mode input (keyboard, mouse, touch, stylus) dan dampak UX workflow.

results.description: Hasil workflow core (create, edit, export, search, simulate) per platform.

exceptions.description: Ketidaksesuaian atau pembatasan yang ditemukan per platform.

limits: Native GUI validation, hosted CI, real hardware, signing, production deployment DEFERRED. Validation is domain-level environment detection and cross-platform workflow simulation.
